from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date, timedelta

from shopkit.config import SETTINGS, Settings
from shopkit.errors import Conflict, ShopError
from shopkit.orders.models import Order
from shopkit.utils.ids import short_code

REASONS = ("damaged", "wrong_item", "not_as_described", "changed_mind")


class ReturnNotAllowed(Conflict):
    pass


class InvalidReturn(ShopError):
    http_status = 422


@dataclass
class ReturnRequest:
    order_id: str
    items: dict[str, int]            # sku -> qty being returned
    reason: str
    code: str = field(default_factory=lambda: short_code(8, groups=4))
    approved: bool = False

    def refund_cents(self, order: Order) -> int:
        prices = {line.sku: line.unit_cents for line in order.lines}
        return sum(prices[sku] * qty for sku, qty in self.items.items())


def open_return(order: Order, delivered_on: date, items: dict[str, int], reason: str,
                today: date, settings: Settings | None = None) -> ReturnRequest:
    settings = settings or SETTINGS
    if reason not in REASONS:
        raise InvalidReturn(f"unknown reason {reason!r}", reason=reason)
    window = settings.return_window_days
    if today > delivered_on + timedelta(days=window):
        raise ReturnNotAllowed(f"order {order.id} is outside the return window", order_id=order.id,
                               delivered_on=delivered_on.isoformat())
    ordered = {line.sku: line.qty for line in order.lines}
    for sku, qty in items.items():
        if qty < 1 or qty > ordered.get(sku, 0):
            raise InvalidReturn(f"cannot return {qty} x {sku}", sku=sku, requested=qty,
                                ordered=ordered.get(sku, 0))
    # changed-mind returns need manual approval; faults are approved automatically
    return ReturnRequest(order.id, dict(items), reason, approved=reason != "changed_mind")

"""Deployment settings.

Every setting has a sensible default and can be overridden with a SHOPKIT_*
environment variable, so the same codebase can be tuned per deployment.
"""
import os
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

DEFAULT_CURRENCIES = ("USD", "CAD", "EUR", "GBP")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Settings:
    default_currency: str = "USD"
    store_country: str = "US"
    low_stock_threshold: int = 10
    invoice_prefix: str = "INV"
    page_size: int = 20
    max_page_size: int = 100
    support_email: str = "support@shopkit.example"
    free_shipping_over_cents: int = 7500
    return_window_days: int = 30
    supported_currencies: tuple[str, ...] = DEFAULT_CURRENCIES
    feature_flags: dict[str, bool] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def flag(self, name: str) -> bool:
        return self.feature_flags.get(name, False)


def _int_env(env: dict[str, str], name: str, default: int) -> int:
    """Read an integer setting; a missing or malformed value falls back to the default."""
    raw = env.get(name)
    if raw is None or not raw.strip():
        return default
    try:
        return int(raw.strip())
    except ValueError:
        return default


def _csv_env(env: dict[str, str], name: str) -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
    raw = env.get(name)
    if raw is None or not raw.strip():
        return None
    return tuple(part.strip() for part in raw.split(",") if part.strip())


def load_settings(env: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> Settings:
    """Build Settings from *env* (defaults to os.environ), applying SHOPKIT_* overrides."""
    env = os.environ if env is None else env
    currencies = _csv_env(env, "SHOPKIT_CURRENCIES")
    enabled = _csv_env(env, "SHOPKIT_FLAGS")
    return Settings(
        default_currency=env.get("SHOPKIT_CURRENCY", "USD"),
        store_country=env.get("SHOPKIT_COUNTRY", "US"),
        low_stock_threshold=_int_env(env, "SHOPKIT_LOW_STOCK", 10),
        invoice_prefix=env.get("SHOPKIT_INVOICE_PREFIX", "INV"),
        page_size=_int_env(env, "SHOPKIT_PAGE_SIZE", 20),
        max_page_size=_int_env(env, "SHOPKIT_MAX_PAGE_SIZE", 100),
        support_email=env.get("SHOPKIT_SUPPORT_EMAIL", "support@shopkit.example"),
        free_shipping_over_cents=_int_env(env, "SHOPKIT_FREE_SHIPPING_OVER_CENTS", 7500),
        return_window_days=_int_env(env, "SHOPKIT_RETURN_DAYS", 30),
        supported_currencies=tuple(c.upper() for c in currencies) if currencies else DEFAULT_CURRENCIES,
        feature_flags={name: True for name in enabled} if enabled else {},
    )


SETTINGS = load_settings()
